description: A shotgunner that sees the player over a 32-high low cover can't climb it (its step height is 18). After shooting over it, it runs into the cover, slides along its face, gets around its south end, and reaches the player. It is never inside the cover.

expect.note: Against the cover's east face (x = 64; its box reaches 16 west of its origin, so it can get no closer than x = 80), level with the cover (y 496 to 528), sliding south along it.
Around the cover and across to the player, stopping about 42 units away as in enemy_chases_up_step.
